definitions.explanation: An ultra-casual abbreviation of {了解|りょうかい} (understood/roger). Used primarily in texting and messaging to quickly acknowledge a message.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}いたら→着く：00680_tsuku⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}して→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧」「りょ！」
examples.english: "Let me know when you get to the station." "Roger!"

examples.japanese: 「⟦お{弁当|べんとう}→お弁当：02864_obentou⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧きて」「りょ。なに⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧？」
examples.english: "Buy a bento on the way." "Got it. What kind?"

notes:
りょ is the ultimate abbreviation of ⟦{了解|りょうかい}→了解：05091_ryoukai⟧ (understood/roger). It represents the trend in Japanese texting culture to shorten acknowledgment words as much as possible.

ABBREVIATION CHAIN:
⟦{了解|りょうかい}→了解：05091_ryoukai⟧ → りょう⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧い → ⟦{了解|りょうかい}→了解：05091_ryoukai⟧ → りょーかい → りょ

Some speakers even abbreviate further to り, though this is less common.

REGISTER:
Extremely casual. Used exclusively in texting, messaging apps (LINE, etc.), and very casual spoken interactions among close friends. Using りょ with superiors, in business, or with people you don't know well would be inappropriate.

ACKNOWLEDGMENT SCALE (casual to formal):
- りょ / り: ultra-casual texting
- ⟦おっけー→オッケー：08757_okkee⟧ / おけ: casual
- ⟦{了解|りょうかい}→了解：05091_ryoukai⟧: casual to neutral
- ⟦{了解|りょうかい}→了解：05091_ryoukai⟧です: polite casual
- ⟦{承知|しょうち}しました→承知する：01835_shouchisuru⟧: formal/business
- かしこまりました: very formal/service industry
